movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Heat Crash
movelist.effect: For each weight class the user is above the target, increase Heat Crash’s Damage Base by +2.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Rollout
movelist.effect: The user continues to use Rollout on each of its turns until they miss any target with Rollout, or are not able to hit any target with Rollout during their turn.  Each successive use of Rollout increases Rollout’s Damage Base by +4 to a maximum of DB 15.

movelist.name: Smog
movelist.effect: Smog Poisons the target on an Even-Numbered Roll.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.effect: The user gains Last Chance with Fire.

abilities.name: Thick Fat
abilities.effect: The user resists Fire-Type and Ice-Type attacks one step further. Defensive.

abilities.name: Bodyguard
abilities.trigger: An adjacent Ally is hit by an attack
abilities.effect: The user and the triggering Ally switch places, and the user becomes the target of the triggering attack instead, taking damage from the attack as if resisted one step further. If switching places would not move the triggering Ally out of the area-of-effect of a Burst, Blast, Cone, or Line, this Ability does not prevent the ally from being hit. Defensive.
